messages.author: 2cc2c22c61b42530
messages.subject: Problem with maptools?
parts:
My app works just fine locally without the library(maptools). But when I want to deploy it I get the following error once all the libraries have been loaded:

Error: maptools package required for this functionality. Please install and try again. Execution halted

Not entirely sure which functionality it is talking about as the code works fine locally I added library(maptools). Now the app won't even deploy:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 11263...
Waiting for task: 73513
  building: Processing Bundle Id: 18189
  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 73514 error: Unhandled Exception: 'utf8' codec can't decode byte 0xf6 in position 6: invalid start byte
> 

Any ideas?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem with maptools?
parts:
Marcus,

I just pushed a fix to the shinyapps package for this issue. If you wouldn't mind updating to the latest version of the shinyapps package on GitHub using the command:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

You can then run deployApp() and let me know if it works.

Thanks!
-Andy
